description: Get a presigned upload for your own audio file — or a SCORE (.mid / .midi / .musicxml / .xml / .mxl → a score_key for doseedo_render_score: send a big score as a file, not as notes in the call). Returns an upload_url (PUT the raw file bytes there, e.g. `curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: <content_type>" --data-binary @song.wav "<upload_url>"`) and an audio_key to pass to doseedo_separate_stems / doseedo_transcribe / doseedo_cover_song / doseedo_audio_to_session, or to doseedo_add_audio_to_session. A FILM (mp4, mov, m4v, webm, mkv; ≤ 2 GB) uploads the same way: pass the key as video_key to doseedo_spot_video / doseedo_score_to_picture. Formats: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, M4A/AAC, Ogg/Opus, WebM — all accepted for processing on every plan. Storing audio IN A SESSION (doseedo_add_audio_to_session) keeps WAV/AIFF/FLAC lossless only on Pro+; below Pro+ lossless is not kept there, so send Opus (audio/ogg). Samples/regions for a session that are on this machine need NO upload: use load_quick_sampler_sample sample_path / attach_audio local_path / set_track_clips audio_ref.local_path and run place_local_files after the download.

content_type.description: MIME type; inferred from the extension when omitted (wav, aif/aiff, flac, mp3, m4a/aac, ogg/opus, webm; a film: mp4, mov, m4v, mkv). Required for any other extension.

filename.description: File name including extension, e.g. "song.wav", "film.mp4", or "cue.mid" / "cue.musicxml" for a score.

name: doseedo_get_upload_url
title: Get an audio upload URL
